description_en: Creates a subscriber for a partition expression by calling CreateQualityFollower
description_zh: 调用CreateQualityFollower创建分区表达式的订阅人
name: CreateQualityFollower

parameters.help_en: The name of the engine or data source
parameters.help_zh: 引擎或者数据源的名称
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The account ID of the subscriber
parameters.name: follower

parameters.help_en:
The notification method. Valid values:

1: email.
2: email and text message.
4: DingTalk chatbot.
5: DingTalk chatbot @ALL.
6: Lark.
7: WeCom.
8: WEBHOOK.
9: phone call alert
parameters.help_zh: 订阅的方式，包括1（邮件）、2（邮件和短信）、4（钉钉群机器人）、5（钉钉群机器人@ALL）、6（飞书）、7（企业微信）、8（WEBHOOK）和9（电话告警）
parameters.name: alarm_mode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the partition expression
parameters.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can obtain the ID from the DataWorks console
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以进入DataWorks管理控制台获取
parameters.name: project_id
